label: Social Media
description: Social platforms: video, microblogging, streaming and profile intelligence.

nodes.label: YouTube: Search Videos
nodes.description: Search YouTube videos by keyword via the Data API v3 search endpoint.
nodes.search: youtube video search find query keyword content data api

credentials.help: Google Cloud API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled

nodes.label: YouTube: Get Channel
nodes.description: Fetch a YouTube channel's snippet and statistics (subscribers, views, video count) by channel ID.
nodes.search: youtube channel subscribers statistics views creator info lookup

credentials.help: Google Cloud API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled

nodes.label: YouTube: List Video Comments
nodes.description: List top-level comment threads on a YouTube video via the Data API v3.
nodes.search: youtube comments video thread replies audience feedback read

credentials.help: Google Cloud API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled

nodes.label: Mastodon: Post Status
nodes.description: Publish a status (toot) to a Mastodon instance via its REST API.
nodes.search: mastodon toot post status publish fediverse microblog write

config.label: Instance URL
config.help: Base URL of your Mastodon instance, no trailing slash

credentials.help: Access token with write:statuses scope (Settings → Development)

nodes.label: Mastodon: Search
nodes.description: Search accounts, statuses and hashtags on a Mastodon instance via the v2 search API.
nodes.search: mastodon search find accounts statuses hashtags fediverse query

config.label: Instance URL
config.help: Base URL of your Mastodon instance, no trailing slash

config.label: Result type
config.help: accounts, hashtags or statuses; empty searches all

credentials.help: Access token with read:search scope (required for full-text status search)

nodes.label: Bluesky: Create Session
nodes.description: Authenticate against Bluesky via com.atproto.server.createSession, returning an access JWT and DID for subsequent XRPC calls.
nodes.search: bluesky atproto login session authenticate token jwt did

credentials.help: App password from Settings → App Passwords (not your main password)

nodes.label: Bluesky: Create Post
nodes.description: Create a post record via com.atproto.repo.createRecord. Requires the access JWT and DID from a bluesky.createSession node upstream.
nodes.search: bluesky post skeet publish write atproto feed create

config.label: Created at
config.help: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp for the record

nodes.label: Bluesky: Search Posts
nodes.description: Search public Bluesky posts via the keyless public AppView API (app.bsky.feed.searchPosts).
nodes.search: bluesky search posts find public keyless atproto feed query

nodes.label: Twitch: Get Streams
nodes.description: Fetch live streams from the Twitch Helix API, filtered by broadcaster login or game ID.
nodes.search: twitch stream live broadcast helix viewers gaming status

config.label: Broadcaster login
config.help: Twitch login name; leave empty with Game ID set to browse by game

credentials.help: Application client ID from the Twitch developer console
App access token from the OAuth client-credentials flow

nodes.label: Twitch: Search Channels
nodes.description: Search Twitch channels by name via the Helix search/channels endpoint.
nodes.search: twitch search channels find streamer broadcaster helix query

config.label: Live only
config.help: true to return only channels currently live

credentials.help: Application client ID from the Twitch developer console
App access token from the OAuth client-credentials flow

nodes.label: X (Twitter): Search Posts
nodes.description: Search recent posts on X via the browser runtime (X's API is gated behind paid tiers, so this reads the public search page).
nodes.search: x twitter search tweets posts find query keyword trending

config.label: URLs
config.help: One URL per line; templated with config values

nodes.label: X (Twitter): Get Profile
nodes.description: Read a public X profile page (bio, follower counts, recent posts) via the browser runtime.
nodes.search: x twitter profile user account bio followers timeline read

config.label: URLs
config.help: One URL per line; templated with config values

nodes.label: Instagram: Get Profile
nodes.description: Read a public Instagram profile page (bio, post grid, counts) via the browser runtime (the Graph API requires app review, so this reads the public page).
nodes.search: instagram profile user account bio followers posts photos read

config.label: URLs
config.help: One URL per line; templated with config values

nodes.label: LinkedIn: Get Company Page
nodes.description: Read a public LinkedIn company page (about, headcount, recent posts) via the browser runtime (LinkedIn's API is partner-gated).
nodes.search: linkedin company page organization employees about business read

config.label: URLs
config.help: One URL per line; templated with config values

nodes.label: TikTok: Get Profile
nodes.description: Read a public TikTok profile page (bio, follower counts, recent videos) via the browser runtime (TikTok's API requires app approval).
nodes.search: tiktok profile user creator account bio followers videos read

config.label: URLs
config.help: One URL per line; templated with config values

nodes.label: Reddit: Get User Posts
nodes.description: Fetch a Reddit user's submitted posts via the keyless public JSON listing.
nodes.search: reddit user posts submissions history profile keyless json read

config.label: Username
config.help: Reddit username without the u/ prefix
